summary: TestFlight Round-4 (v1.0.12 / build 119) verification of the 3 bugs Garry found in build 118 manual QA on iPhone. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter87_testflight_round4.py — 19/19 tests PASS covering: app.json version/build pins locked at 1.0.12/119 (unchanged); Bug 14 onboarding ending — GeorgeOnboarding.tsx now renders a single primary '☕ Head to FP Café' button + 'Finish later' tertiary, 'Change something' and 'That looks right' labels removed from JSX (only survive in explanatory comments), closing George turn contains 'Why not head over to the FP Café first?', and GeorgeButterfly.onDone routes to /(tabs)/lounge after approve; Bug 15 George voice consistency — GeorgeRemembersBanner.tsx imports and renders GeorgeSpeakButton (cloud TTS via georgeApi.speak) with no legacy SpeakButton import remaining; Bug 16 STT empty audio + raw error — VoiceInputButton.tsx has 250ms iOS flush wait after recorder.stop(), blob-size guard (>=500 bytes), friendly copy 'Sorry, I couldn't hear anything. critical_code_review_comments: GeorgeOnboarding.tsx L245-250: single primary Pressable renders '☕ Head to FP Café' onPress=approve, followed by tertiary 'Finish later' Pressable. No 'Change something' / 'That looks right' JSX remains — only comments describing the retirement.

GeorgeButterfly.tsx L473-487: <Modal> around GeorgeOnboarding — onDone closes chat, refreshes presence, then `router.push('/(tabs)/lounge')` inside a try/catch. Correctly routes new members straight to FP Café after profile approval.

GeorgeRemembersBanner.tsx L25: `import GeorgeSpeakButton from '@/src/components/george/GeorgeSpeakButton'`. L144: `<GeorgeSpeakButton text={spokenText} color={c.brand} size={22} />` — no legacy `SpeakButton` import or usage remains.
VoiceInputButton.tsx L206-212: `await recorder.stop(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); audioUri = recorder.uri;` — 250ms iOS flush wait is in place before reading the URI.
VoiceInputButton.tsx L243-249: blob size < 500 guard fires the friendly copy `Sorry, I couldn't hear anything. Please try again.` and resets state — never surfaces raw backend text.
VoiceInputButton.tsx L263-267: 401/403 branch throws `You'll need to sign in again to use voice input.`; all other non-OK statuses map to `Sorry, I couldn't hear you clearly. Please try again.`.
VoiceInputButton.tsx L287-292: catch block strips any message that starts with '{' (raw JSON leak) and substitutes the warm sentence before calling onError.
app.json L5-L6/L14/L58: version=1.0.12, iOS buildNumber=119, Android versionCode=119 — pins unchanged as required.
